notes.title: Winterfest Is Upon Ye!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/367b8a27a9b92a7ed11bc8d65d53129cf78ab294.png

Hear ye!  Hear Ye! Winterfest is upon Ye!

Impostoclaus’ favorite time of the year is here once again.  Mount Krampus is abuzz with excitement as knights begin the annual task to Save Winterfest!! 

As with previous years, the Grinchlins aim to ruin Winterfest for everyone, and they're making a pretty strong showing. No amount of coal or yellow snowballs has deterred them.  Impostoclaus needs assistance in the Save Winterfest prestige mission!  Help out and earn red, green, and white Winter Wish tokens. Trade your tokens with Randolph in Haven:

Red Winter Wishes for:

Santy Sallet 
Snowy Santy Hat 
Winter Confetti (15)
Flawed Snowball (15) 
Frosty Prize Box 


Green Winter Wishes for:

Santy Pith Hat 
Snowy Pith Hat 
Winter Confetti (15) 
Flawed Snowball (15)
Frosty Prize Box


White Winter Wishes for:

Tailed Santy Hat 
Snowy Tailed Santy Hat
Winter Confetti (15) 
Flawed Snowball (15) 
Frosty Prize Box 


Winterfest Danger Rooms in the Clockworks:  From these random encounters, you can collect Frozen Winterfest Wishlist tokens. Impostoclaus' trusty assistant, Randolph, is stationed by the Haven fountain and will trade these tokens for Winterfest Prize Boxes, in which you may find:

Candy Striped Onesie
Festively Striped Onesie
Holly Striped Onesie
Joyous Striped Onesie
Flashy Winter Pullover
Garish Winter Pullover
Gaudy Winter Pullover
Tacky Winter Pullover
Impostoclaus Outfit


Grinchlin Assault Prestige Mission

Invade the Grinchlin base of operations on Mount Krampus and put an end to their humbug! Face a choice at each shelter - collect loot and leave the mountain, or leave the treasure and climb further toward the summit! 

Can you make it all the way to the summit? If so, you have a chance to win Golden or Silver Solstice Rings. These 4* trinkets protect against fire and freeze with a +1 health bonus. Leave them as-is, or combine them to craft a 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

The Mysterious Alchemy Machine is also available and producing various festive themed weapons for your all of your holiday needs.  Although some sound tasty, it is for external application only and we do not recommend licking them.  Collect special materials from Mount Krampus to craft 5* Grinchlin reskinned weapons:


Deadly Candy Poker
Nog Blaster 
Jack Froster
Scalding Hot Cocoa
Humbug Hazer
Peppermint Repeater


Decoration Kit Prize Boxes

Get into the spirit of Winterfest by decorating your guild hall! These boxes, provisioned by the Supply Depot, may contain items like:

Holiday Presents (red, green, white)
Candles (red, green, white)
Winterfest Trees (red, green, white)
Winterfest Tables (it has a platter of cookies and milk on it)
Blue Wandering Snipes
White Flying Snipes
Green Wandering Snipes


For more information, cast your eyes over here.

Winterfest is here on Spiral Knights through January 2, 2019, so tell your friends and guildies to come on over!

notes.title: All That's Golden
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/2133259018cabb1fd81716303f96a42b2047d4e6.png

Fall is upon us and it's a time for Cradle to celebrate their annual traditions.  Each year we like to celebrate with waddling snipes, an event, and perhaps a good deal on some gear.

Late Harves Prize Box

The leaves have turned and a cold chill is in the air.  The citizens of Haven are bringing in the last of the harvest before it freezes.  The right tools and gear are essential for collecting the sweet remains of this year's bounty.

This rakishly handsome gear includes such items like Scythes, Late Harvest Leaf Crowns, Late Harvest Leaf Chains, and other accessories.  

The Late Harvest Prize Boxes contains items such as:

Untimely Scythe
Shadow Scythe
Late Harvest Leaf Crowns & Chains
Late Harvest Hibiscus Crowns & Chains
Late Harvest Frasera Crowns & Chains
Late Harvest Daisy Crowns & Chains
Late Harvest Armor and Helms
Various new accessories


More information on the Late Harves Prize Boxes and its contents may be found here.  Fall into a pile of Late Harvest Prize Boxes today! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/0970c98b033567b2bf240b50252e3332ac482759.png

Apocrean Harvester

Warning knights! We have confirmed that the Apocrean Harvester has returned again.  Spiral HQ needs your help! 

From now through November 29th, travel onto the Grasping Plateau full of trapped souls and phantom-like monsters. In a maze-like graveyard, knights will find the Apocrea trapping and collecting souls. This sinister being will pursue any who enter the Grasping Plateau hoping to add to the collection. Work together to free souls and find Apocrean Sigil tokens which can be used at the Obelisk of Creation to craft Obsidian weapons and the Grasping Aura. 

You don't want to get caught out there alone--definitely bring your friends with you on this mission, and try not to lose sight of them!  For a detailed brief on Cradle's previous encounters with this nefarious entity, go here.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/2687068fb0f9705663f7ef482b2f1169f30f7ec1.jpg

Gobble Snipes

Our plump little friends, the Gobble Snipes, are on their yearly migration to...we're not really sure where. Hmm.  To protect them in transit we Spiral HQ has enclosed them in Gobble Snipe Boxes Boxes.  Rest assured I’ve been told there are air holes this time.  

Should you wish to host one of these fluffy creatures in your Guild Hall, these boxes can be had through November 23, 2018. Check out the details here!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/005df063e5bf98f44601c34e1cd14be67093952c.png

Cyber Monday 

This Cyber Monday we're having some quick movin’ flash sales!  Monday, November 26 you'll find fire crystals, keys, accessories, and more rotating through the Depot, so check back often!  Ye may even notice interesting items in the featured auctions.

notes.title: Summer Tech Kat Event!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/a5d61459fa765944d5b44ded77291fd4c1d98c2e.png

Kataclysmic Confrontation Returns

Black kats are once again storming the Moorcroft Manor Archives and consuming the precious tomes within! We need all knights of rank 4-1 and greater to gear up and retrieve Ancient Pages from these nefarious creatures.  The event will run through July 17th.

Accept the Kataclysmic Confrontation prestige mission and/or fight through kat levels in the Clockworks to find black kats. Then, visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the Mysterious Alchemy Machine in Haven, with your collection of Ancient Pages, to craft some Kat related gear.

If you “accidentally” perform a Dark Ritual and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or a Wicked Whisker which allow you to craft the following gear:

Kat Claw cloak, mail, raiment
Kat Hiss cloak, mail, raiment
Kat Eye cloak, mail, raiment
Black Kat cloak, mail, raiment, hood, mask

If you have participated in a previous Kataclysmic Confrontation and still have Ancient Page tokens, they are still valid!  Ancient Page tokens do not expire.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/65ac38dd246826d083fcb66b028ed33dfdf42051.png

SummerTech - Beat The Heat

The heat of summer is baking the residents of Cradle.  Spiral HQ’s Department of Gremlin Engineering has done some extensive research and determined that the highly visible tech colors useful in winter also help knights blend in when infiltrating summer festivities.  To that end, we’ve issued some high tech gear designed to aid knights when storming the beaches.  Check out the Tech Blue, Tech Green, Tech Orange, and Tech Pink summer gear while you’re trying to beat the heat by the pool or in Firestorm Citadel.  This technical gear includes such items like a Tech Charcoalers, Tech Furious Forks, Tech Spiral Soakers, Boaters, Floppy Beach Hats, and various SummerTech accessories.  

The SummerTech Box contains items such as:

Tech Charcoaler
Tech Furious Fork
Tech Spiral Soaker
Boater
Floppy Beach Hat
Splash Sarong
Splash Trunks
Various new accessories


More information on the SummerTech Box and its contents may be found here.  Surf’s up!

notes.title: The Apocrean Harvester Is Back!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/0970c98b033567b2bf240b50252e3332ac482759.png

ATTENTION KNIGHTS!

The season of the Apocrean Harvester is upon us again, and Spiral HQ needs your help in beating it back into dormancy! For a detailed brief on this nefarious entity, go here.

Get equipped and venture onto the Grasping Plateau, free trapped souls, and earn Apocrean Sigil tokens for your heroic deeds. Knights can use these tokens at the Obelisk of Creation to craft Obsidian weapons and the Grasping Aura.  

Take care while in the field!  You don't want to get caught out there alone--definitely bring your friends with you on this mission, and never leave a knight behind!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/d4a413a22ac67555fc2904fcd276d5a65650f257.png

Obsidian Prize Boxes

While the event is going, the Supply Depot will stock Obsidian Prize Boxes you can obtain with energy.  These may contain the following:

Obsidian Hoods 
Obsidian Mantles
Apocrean Crowns
Apocrean Disciple Wings
Shadow accessories


The Auction House will be stocking some Apocrean themed guild hall furniture to give your guild hall a touch of terror… er… class.

For details on the Obsidian Prize Box along with the odds for each item, head over here. This event runs through June 17, 2018.

notes.title: Just Wing It
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/f6a60110dfd19fc3ff1e761156f2183185699023.png

Greetings Knights!

Some knights were made ready to take off on adventure and reach new heights.  For these knights, Spiral HQ has created a special set of items.  Soar into Aerodynamic Boxes to zero in on costumes, Contrails Auras, Swing Wings, and all new accessories.

In order to maintain altitude, it’s important to be able to keep your speed up and maintain your course.  That’s why we’ve manufactured a Airbraker shield.  This shield helps deflect any incoming projectiles while in a chaotic dogfight.  If that doesn’t work, dash away and hope your Chaff Pack distracts them.

The Aerodynamic Box contains items such as:

Airbraker shield
Contrails Aura
Swing Wings
Chaff Pack - Give it a Dash!
New Dynamic Accessories
Costumes
Accessories


More information on the Aerodynamic Prize Box and its contents may be found here.

Additional Notes:

A new accessory slot has been added for the ankle area.  This way you can wear a back accessory along with something to keep your ankles warm.  If you already had some slippers or other ankle accessories attached, they should automatically be moved to the ankle slot.
We believe we are now finished with some extensive work to our back end.  You’ve noticed this ongoing work, but it should now be complete.  In doing so, we fixed several long standing problems like the bug reporting system, Steam inventory icons, and several non-player facing issues.
As mentioned before, the bug reporting system is now in working order.  This means you can file a bug report by hitting F2.  You do this to send a log of what happened to us and report a bug you’ve seen to developers.  If you need help in game, please continue to contact support so they know.  Support does not review and respond to bug reports, they respond to requests and emails.

notes.title: Spiral Knights 7th Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/41c822cba90bc64a82562aba9ddb1090734f7faf.png

Caketastrophe!

Happy Birthday Spiral Knights

Spiral Knights is SEVEN years old!  It’s time again to help Biscotti, the Skylark's Head Chef, avoid disaster in two special missions - Total Caketastrophe and A Gremlin in Knead. Fight Creep Cakes and Batterbots to earn Cake Slice tokens, then visit Maskwell in Haven Town Square to exchange your tokens for:

- Cake helms
- Anniversary Prize Boxes
- Other party accessories

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/f2cc993bddd4fbcdb5d888b66b896a13c7bbe34d.jpg

Surprise Boxes!

Today through April 25, 2018: Spiral HQ has assembled prize boxes from the past year together into a Surprise Box. When you open a Surprise Box, you will randomly receive a past prize box and confetti. There is also a chance to find a Stately Cap costume helm! For details on this box and its contents, visit the wiki here.

Thank you all so much for playing Spiral Knights. Have fun out there!

Additional Release Notes:

- Slight changes to how the Mixmaster, Caladbolg, and Buccaneer Broadsider animate.
- Special gear animations are now shown when viewing your own Equipment or inspecting another knight.
- Cracked fire crystals can be sold to vendors for 1 crown.
- Increase max statues per guild hall to 10 (from 8).
- Slight changes to the player creation UI.  
- The depot confirm-purchase popup now shows you the quantity (ie. “Quantity: 50”) if not buying just 1.

notes.title: Running Wild With Tortodrones
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/1f9d97e2e5dac1d6cbb42fd78d6f4b8dec9e58a0.png
Greetings!

Today we have a small patch fix, the Tortodrone Migration, and a celebration of the Year of the Dog.

Patch fix:

Fix the explosions caused by Violent Heart Attack to scale with depth
Added a new icon for auras that utilize a footstep effect
Emote / talking animations now play in the ready room
Various behind the scenes improvements


The pack here at spiral HQ are happy to ring in the Chinese New Year with a howl.  We’ve doggedly pursued Wolvers from across Cradle to help us celebrate, but they were more interested in trying to bite us. 

This year we’re celebrating with a pupdate full of pawsh hound inspired gear.  These fetching new items accessories are sure to help keep you warm - Just watch out for fleas.  Show foes what you think of them while wearing a doggie tail.  This accessory has curious animations that change depending on your mood.  Retrieve a Running Wild Boxes now before they scamper away after March 21st.

The Running Wild contains items such as:

Wild Aura (footstep aura)
Alpha Claw Gauntlet
Love Puppy (Seraphynx Sprite)
Doggie Tails - New animation
Wolver Masks
Alpha Vertical Vents
Treat Pouches 
Wild Bone Pendants
Various other tawny accessories


More information on the Running Wild Box and its contents may be found here.  It’s wild out there, be sure to keep close to your pack.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/796d819e5c782b70402e80e9a3e06fd64db9b64f.jpg

Spiral HQ calls upon you to once again assist the Tortodrones on their Long Migration. Take up arms to defend these creatures, and explore the Clockworks to gather fiendish glyphs.

Be sure to collect Ancient Shell materials from the Ancient Grove to craft 3*, 4* and 5* Tortodrone handguns and shields at the Mysterious Alchemy Machine!

The Spiral HQ intel forecasting interns predicts the Tortodrone migration will continue through February 25, 2018. We’re counting on you to protect the magnificent Tortodrones!

notes.title: A Chilly Winterfest Arrives on Cradle
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/b62eff29a0f6f9780ae5e332b2fad5eb3ded62d5.png

Happy  Winterfest!  This is our annual holiday event and celebration! 

All the creatures of Cradle are celebrating the season with snow, festive songs, and hats. Some Gremlins say "Humbug!" and plan to stop Impostoclaus and destroy Winterfest! Stop the Grinchlins from destroying Winterfest with two daily prestige missions.

Visit Impostoclaus' helper, Randolph, near the fountain in Haven to exchange tokens for festive helms, winter confetti, and snowballs.

Raid the Grinchlin stronghold on Mount Krampus to stop them from ruining Winterfest! Make your way through the compound, all the way to the summit to find special 4* Solstice Ring trinkets. Combine them together to make the 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

Visit the Supply Depot for Decoration Kits for your guild hall and gift boxes to wrap your gifts and attach a note! Take a moment at the Mysterious Alchemy Machine. There's a handgun that's minty fresh! 

Click here for more details.

notes.title: Shades of Grey and the Style Kit Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/33f85dfb9ee1228f843fdf1133b174467d8e4bf5.png


Greetings Knights!

In an effort to make it easier to give your knight the best look, the gremlins at Spiral HQ have created a Style Kit.  Now you can easily swap between appearance modifiers (personal colors, eyes, and height) once you have added them to your Kit.  


Access your Style Kit through the knight portrait in the upper left of the screen.
Once you have your kit, any modifier you use will be added to that kit.  
You can swap between items you have used using the menu for a small fee.  The fee is to help prevent people from spamming public areas with changes and would distracting to other players.
Vatel will now offer to sell height modifiers.
Modifiers you have previously used will not be added, only those you use after this point.


With fall here and knights using their Style Kits, Haven is bursting with color.  But once a knight descends into the Clockworks their decisions aren't black and white, they're somewhere in the Grey.  With this in mind, Spiral HQ has put together a box for knights with singular tastes.

Dig into a Grey Prize Box and find a grey costumes, accessories, a grey footstep aura, or sprite pods.  Lucky knights might find a Silver Personal Color that they can add to their Style Kit.  This silver color change will not be added to Vatel’s inventory in Haven.

The Grey Prize Box contains items such as:

Silver Personal Color
Grey Aura
Maskeraith Pod (Grey), Drakon Pod (Grey), and Seraphynx Pod (Grey)
Grey Dragon and Valkyrie Wings
Costumes
Accessories


More information on the Grey Prize Box and its contents may be found here.

Statue Sale:

With the above release it is now possible to make a statue of your knight that actually looks like a statue! With that in mind we're reducing the price of statues through this month. If the statue you want is not on sale, please check back later. You'll know it's on sale by the "sale" tag on the icon before you purchase it.

notes.title: Dark Harvest Festival Is Back!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/4448d801ceb41cd35ef90ee138bd1400ac64797a.png


The Dark Harvest Festival is Back! It’s no trick, the Punkin King and his gourdlings are causing sweet, sweet chaos in the Clockworks!

Find the Punkin King in the daily prestige mission, The Dark Harvest.  However, don't let your guard down, because he could also show up elsewhere when you least expect it! Collect candy tokens, then trade with Maskwell in Haven Town Square for:

Frankenzom masks
Spookat masks
Phantom masks
Scarab masks
Harvest Prize Boxes - New Harvest Accessories!


Should you find yourself in possession of any interesting crafting material as a result of a Punkin King encounter, visit the Mysterious Alchemy Machine.

More about the Dark Harvest Festival can be found here.  The Dark Harvest Prize Box 2017 has been reworked to include new accessories within the Dark Harvest theme.  Trade in your tokens to discover some of the new offerings.  This year, the festival runs through November 1, 2017. Your candy tokens and Maskwell will stick around through November 5, 2017.

Additional Patch Notes:

- New Dark Harvest 2017 prize box replaces the old Dark Harvest box and swaps in a number of new/different accessories and removes many of the old ones.  This way people who have participated in past Dark Harvest Festivals can earn new items.
- Small fix to the hallway in front of the war room in the guild halls to allow furniture to be placed.

notes.title: Kataclysmic Confrontation!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/a5d61459fa765944d5b44ded77291fd4c1d98c2e.png


ATTENTION ALL KNIGHTS

We are declaring a state of emergency in the Moorcroft Manor Archives, as black kats are once again storming the area and consuming the precious tomes within! We need all knights of rank 4-1 and greater to gear up and retrieve Ancient Pages from these voracious vermin. 

Do the Kataclysmic Confrontation prestige mission and/or fight through kat levels in the Clockworks to find black kats. Then, visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the Mysterious Crafting Machine in Haven, with your collection of Ancient Pages, and craft stuff:

Kat Claw hood, mask, cowl
Kat Hiss hood, mask, cowl
Kat Eye hood, mask, cowl


If you happen to perform (accidentally, we assume) a Dark Ritual (yes, THAT dark ritual) and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or a Wicked Whisker. With Wicked Whiskers, dropped for all present party members, the following gear can be made:

Kat Claw cloak, mail, raiment
Kat Hiss cloak, mail, raiment
Kat Eye cloak, mail, raiment
Black Kat cloak, mail, raiment, hood, mask

If you have participated in a previous Kataclysmic Confrontation and still have Ancient Page tokens, they are still valid! Ancient Page tokens do not expire.

Our new Kat Forecasting Intern predicts that the Kataclysmic Confrontation will run through August 3, 2017.  Best of luck, knights!

ALERT KNIGHTS!
 
The heat of the Summer Solstice has lured the Apocrean Harvester to claim more souls.  Spiral HQ needs your help!
  
From now through July 5th, venture onto the Grasping Plateau, free trapped souls, and earn Apocrean Sigil tokens for your bravery. Then, use these tokens at the Obelisk of Creation to craft Obsidian weapons and the Grasping Aura.  
  
For a detailed brief on Cradle's previous encounters with this nefarious entity, go here.
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/412c98e993fbdbfb6084bbd288a19c24d6dd55bc.png

In these boxes, you may find the following items:
 
- Variant Tickets
- Crest of Summer / Crest of Winter
- Wings of Summer / Wings of Winter
- Sunshine Aura
- Snowfall Aura

notes.title: Starlight Cradle Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/724a87fdf56efbe935f55b38215915e4055a2b29.png

Rise and shine Knights!

Grab your favorite caffeinated beverage and take a look at some of the changes and new additions you’ll find in the game:

Starlight Cradle levels can be found in T2 and T3.
- These levels are part of normal gate rotation, not a new mission set.
- These levels may contain a drowsy Sloom, the fearsome Sloombargo, and other slimes.  
- You may also stumble across some optional danger rooms that will give you a run for your money.
- Gates will be cycled after release so that some starlight cradle levels are immediately available.
- Zee cores will now drop from these levels and can be used in the crafting of some new gear (see below).

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/f377ffbb09409045ec8640a57d74823276f0e514.png

Reintroduction of the “sleep” status.
- This has been reworked.
- Sleep will render a victim completely unresponsive until woken.
- Because sleep can be rejuvenating, you may notice a small (and limited) heal upon waking up.
- If you find yourself asleep and vulnerable, look to a party member to wake you up with “gentle” poke of a bullet or blade.
- Remedy should wake you from sleep.  Think of it as a dose of caffeine.
- After sleep you will acquire an 'alert' status that protects you from sleep for a few moments.

New Helms and Armor
- Padded Demo Helm
- Padded Demo Suit
- Padded Hunting Cap
- Padded Hunting Coat
- Quilted Demo Helm
- Quilted Demo Suit
- Quilted Hunting Cap
- Quilted Hunting Coat
- Starlit Demo Helm
- Starlit Demo Suit
- Starlit Hunting Cap
- Starlit Hunting Coat

New Weapons
- Advanced Cautery Sword
- Amputator
- Slumber Smogger
- Slumber Smogger Mk II
- Slumber Squall
- Torpor Tantrum

Knight Statues are now available.
- If Bechamel is installed in a guild, she will now sell knight statues of knights for energy.  When in Haven, Bechamel will not offer to sell statues.
- Statues are a furniture item depicting your knight wearing what you wore when you purchased it.  
- There are multiple sizes of statues to purchase.
- Warning:  Review all parts of the statute carefully in the preview window.  There are no refunds for mistaken wardrobe choices or refunds if a particular accessory or aura does not display correctly.
- A guild may only have 8 statues placed in their hall at any given time.
- You may need to ‘publish’ your guild hall to get the new option from Bechamel.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/81ea8f363eb704590563b89a4dfda6c9fcb2874f.png

Additional Changes:

- Guild officers and above can sell materials in their treasury to birdsong for half the normal price. This should help guilds clear unwanted items from their inventory.

- In Lockdown, the Guardian’s shield now has more health.

- A few changes to the chat filter to remove ‘Gay’ and ‘muff’.  Be aware that it is still against the Terms of Service to use any of these words in a derogatory fashion and we will take action accordingly.

- Fixed some issues with placing furniture near the entrance of a guild hall.

- Fixed a small graphics glitch in Firestorm Citadel, Charred Court.

notes.title: Diamond Hardcore: Fortress
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/75139d1a89cdcec51f9f9f816cd383e29b3003ae.png

Greetings Knights!

Adventurous knights are constantly under pressure in the Clockworks.  Few substances have the strength to handle it like Diamond.  What better way to prove that than to use it as armor?  As an added bonus, you’ll be able to blind your enemy with its flawless brilliance.

This month Spiral HQ will start the process of completing the gem sets for those who were waiting for a specific month.

The Diamond Prize Box contains items such as:

Diamond Aura
Floating Diamonds
Diamond Disciple Wings
Diamond Crown
Diamond Wolver Tail
Diamond Cat Tail
Diamond Costume and Accessories


More information on the Diamond Prize Box and its contents may be found here.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/df69023ef4150d6c0e324e6687a5ab6782c050f7.png

As an added bonus, Spiral HQ has decided it’s time to toss another challenge your way.  Based on feedback, we’ve decided to make a few changes and release another map.  To that end, we’ve asked our gremlin engineer to prepare the following changes to lockdown this weekend:


New Map:  Fortress.  Fortress is a small castle arena filled with fire pots and littered with fire safety memos.  Like other new maps, you will have a higher likelihood of seeing it now, however it will remain in the game after the event is over.
Control points once again have obstacles that will cause both teams a number of problems including status effects.  Be on the lookout for new hazards!
Auto-Target is off.


Side note:  Below are a few of the rejected names for the new map.  Some were rejected for obvious reasons.


Book Burner
Cookin’ the Books
Page Burner
Bonfire of the Vanities
Pyromance Novels
THE ROOF THE ROOF... wait there's a roof?
Why use my level 10 weapons when I can toss a pot?!

notes.title: Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/3e4f8cc0fa234fdcfd65d776545acc98f9fd0b9b.png

Spiral Knights is SIX years old! Happy Birthday Spiral Knights!

Come help us celebrate Spiral Knights' birthday!

Help Biscotti, the Skylark's Head Chef, avoid disaster in two special missions - Total Caketastrophe and A Gremlin in Knead. Fight Creep Cakes and Batterbots to earn Cake Slice tokens, then visit Maskwell in Haven Town Square to exchange your tokens for:

- Cake helms
- Anniversary Prize Boxes
- Other party accessories

Lucky knights may also stumble upon a Casino and find cake tokens among the other prizes on the wheel.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/ff8d24745ab2f804362abce6823201223c54b7c4.png

Today through April 17, 2017: Spiral HQ has assembled prize boxes from the past year together into a Surprise Box. When you open a Surprise Box, you will randomly receive a past prize box and confetti. There is also a chance to find a Stately Cap costume helm! For details on this box and its contents, visit the wiki here.

Thank you all so much for playing Spiral Knights!  We've had a busy year at Grey Havens setting up a new home for Cradle.  We're excited that we're now able to focus more on the development of the game.  

This year has seen the addition of the Casino, new items for guild halls, new PvP modes, new events, new items, various bug fixes, and a few new PvP maps.  It's our hope that next year brings even more from our gremlin engineers who are already hard at work.

notes.title: A Hazardous Spring Equinox
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/146def3a41444a74cd6283116a5b8c905a2d6a3a.png

Hail, knights!

The cosmos briefly swings into balance--just in time for you to take on a new challenge! First, Spiral HQ is upping the challenge this weekend for this Hardcore Lockdown Event.  Please expect the following changes this weekend:


New Map:  Icebox.  This is a freeze themed level with some knight-controllable traps.  This map will still be available after the event is over, but will be seen fairly often for a while.
Auto-Target is off.
Control points now have even more obstacles that will cause both teams a number of problems.  Some of these problems will be more insurmountable than others.
Bug Fix: Orbital hazards now deal their proper status effects.


To mark this occasion, the Strangers have brought forth celestially-themed offerings in the Spring Equinox Prize Box, available to you through March 24th, 2017:


Celestial Vortex
Celestial Saber
Orbit Aura
Celestial Nav Helm and Suit
Galactic Guardian Helm and Vest
Solar and Cosmic Plasma Wings
Celestial Dragon/Valkyrie Wings
Celestial Accessories
Unique Variant Tickets


For the full rundown on the Equinox Prize Box, check here.

If all of this leaves you wanting to adopt a buddy who always has your back (or front); keep an eye out for Nonna near the Haven fountain!

notes.title: Celebrate the Year of the Rooster.. with Kats!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/245d21de1d6a21b61288961e015efbd9edd6d0fe.png
ATTENTION KNIGHTS

We here at Spiral HQ would like to wish you luck in the Year of the fire snipe… er… Rooster!  We’re celebrating the new year by equipping knights with gear that would make any Rooster envious.  The Rooster Prize Box is available through March 2, 2017.  

These contain all new items in various colors, such as:

Buhgok Tails
Fowl Cloaks
Fowl Cowls
Wattlesnipes
Feathered Auras


More information on the Rooster Prize Box and its contents may be found here.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/990d859e2aa034ab587ed4f097f142db94fac8b7.png

An over abundance of roosters has also spurred other creatures to descend on the Clockworks.  As you may have suspected, the black kats are once again storming the Moorcroft Manor Archives and consuming the valuable tomes it stores! We need all knights of rank 4-1 and greater to gear up!  Do not fear going forward slowly knights; fear only to stand still.

You can find black kats in the Kataclysmic Confrontation prestige mission and various kat levels in the Clockworks. Be sure to collect Ancient Pages and visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the Mysterious Crafting Machine in Haven, to obtain event themed items.  If you perform a Dark Ritual and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or some materials which will allow you to craft some event exclusive gear.

More information on the Kataclysmic Confrontation can be found on the wiki here.  If you have participated in a previous Confrontation and still have Ancient Page tokens, they are still valid! Ancient Page tokens do not expire.  The Kataclysmic Confrontation will run through February 22nd.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/686a0d14df286d5fcfdee5ec6a8e5bc2f6e7ce71.png

Ready to celebrate all things love puppy? Check the supply depot for some special gifts and and come join our Valentine forum event:

notes.title: Scarlet Scouts Equipment!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/e73eb760219218141907635730c2543c953eca7a.png

Have you been sitting around Haven looking for a challenge?  If so, Rhendon is looking for elite recruits to join the Scarlet Scouts!

The Scarlet Scouts, like Recon Rangers, are tasked with traveling fast and light across treacherous land throughout Cradle.  The Scouts are tasked with delicate and dangerous missions designed to help those in need.

You might recall your own extraction not so long ago, when Rhendon guided you from your crash site to Haven. If you want to help out with these ongoing efforts, supplies can be found in the Hazardous Prize Box, available through January 30, 2017. 

These contain such items as:

Hazardous Dragon Wings (new)
The Final Gasp (shield)
Scarlet Scout Crest

notes.title: Winterfest Is Upon Us!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/a783637a071156d2d884a5ff7ab1a92cc75676fc.png

Hear ye!  Hear Ye! Winterfest is here!

Impostoclaus’ favorite time of the year is here once again.

Here's the rundown of the events for those who have yet to help end the humbug on Mount Krampus:

Save Winterfest!

Those Grinchlins just won't quit. As with last year, they aim to ruin Winterfest for everyone, and they're making a pretty strong showing. Impostoclaus needs assistance in the Save Winterfest prestige mission!  Help out to earn red, green, and white Winter Wish tokens. Trade with Randolph in Haven:

Red Winter Wishes for:

Santy Sallet 
Snowy Santy Hat 
Winter Confetti (15)
Flawed Snowball (15) 
Frosty Prize Box 


Green Winter Wishes for:

Santy Pith Hat 
Snowy Pith Hat 
Winter Confetti (15) 
Flawed Snowball (15)
Frosty Prize Box


White Winter Wishes for:

Tailed Santy Hat 
Snowy Tailed Santy Hat
Winter Confetti (15) 
Flawed Snowball (15) 
Frosty Prize Box 


Winterfest Danger Rooms in the Clockworks:  From these random encounters, you can collect Frozen Winterfest Wishlist tokens. Impostoclaus' trusty assistant, Randolph, is stationed by the Haven fountain and will trade these tokens for Winterfest Prize Boxes, in which you may find:

Candy Striped Onesie
Festively Striped Onesie
Holly Striped Onesie
Joyous Striped Onesie
Flashy Winter Pullover
Garish Winter Pullover
Gaudy Winter Pullover
Tacky Winter Pullover
Impostoclaus Outfit


Grinchlin Assault Prestige Mission

Invade the Grinchlin base of operations on Mount Krampus and put an end to their humbug! Face a choice at each shelter - collect loot and leave the mountain, or leave the treasure and climb further toward the summit! 

Can you make it all the way to the summit? If so, you have a chance to win Golden or Silver Solstice Rings. These 4* trinkets protect against fire and freeze with a +1 health bonus. Leave them as-is, or combine them to craft a 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

The Mysterious Alchemy Machine is also available and producing various festive themed weapons for your all of your holiday needs.  Although some sound tasty, it is for external application only and we do not recommend licking them.  Collect special materials from Mount Krampus to craft 5* Grinchlin reskinned weapons:


Deadly Candy Poker
Nog Blaster 
Jack Froster
Scalding Hot Cocoa
Humbug Hazer
Peppermint Repeater


Decoration Kit Prize Boxes

Get into the spirit of Winterfest by decorating your guild hall! These boxes, provisioned by the Supply Depot, may contain items like:

Holiday Presents (red, green, white)
Candles (red, green, white)
Winterfest Trees (red, green, white)
Winterfest Tables (it has a platter of cookies and milk on it)
Blue Wandering Snipes
White Flying Snipes
Green Wandering Snipes


For more information, cast your eyes over here.

Winterfest is here on Spiral Knights through January 3, 2017, so tell your friends and guildies to come on over!

notes.title: Frozen Gobble Snipes
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/b363f76d23bef6c00b1eff9c198472182a462d94.png

Greetings knights!

The cold of winter is descending on Cradle. To keep knights moving during the most extreme cold conditions, Spiral HQ has issued chilling new gear. Blend into any frozen environment with frosty gear and accessories.  

While these items look frozen solid on the outside--for camo reasons, and also because it looks formidable--they're mighty toasty on the inside.  Think of them as Cradle's most efficient travel coffee mug.  Take care with the new permafrost aura as it may leave a puddle in warmer places.

Contents include:
* Permafrost Aura (new)
* Crystalline Defender (new, shield)
* Maskeraith (Freeze) Pod
* Arctic Acolyte Mantle (new)
* Arctic Acolyte Hood (new)
* Arctic Disciple Wings
* Arctic Crown
* Arctic Shackles
* Arctic Pauldrons
* Additional new armors and helms
* New accessories

Glacial 2016 prize boxes are available from now through December 11th, 2016, and details on the box can be found here.

Knights will also notice that our seasonal buddies, the Gobble Snipes, are on their yearly migration to...we're not really sure where. Hmm.  

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/2687068fb0f9705663f7ef482b2f1169f30f7ec1.jpg

A few of these Gobble Snipes seem to want to stay in a few guild halls. At least, we think that's what it means when they enclose themselves in Gobble Snipe Boxes.  Should you wish to host one of these fluffy creatures in your Guild Hall, these boxes can be had through December 1, 2016. Check out the details here!

notes.title: Iron Guild Hall Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/012c6a44d86f45edd0ab484762b9eac098cf5bb5.png
Greetings!

Spiral HQ “Hall Edition” is back and looking for some DIY knights to help revitalize their guild halls.  Only the most advanced guilds can work together to create a hall that other knights would be envious of.  Use the new Iron and Copper furniture to create your very own place to train, strategize, or hang out.  

Release notes:

- Guild Hall upkeep prices have been significantly lowered.
- The Activities panel now gives you an option to see a list of all open Guild Halls.
- New guild hall furniture available. Copper and Iron items will rotate weekly.  If what you're looking for isn't there, check back again.
- New guild hall theme “Divine” is available.
- New Rain Storm environment
- New ‘empty’ room: Chess Board.
- New Modular counter tops added to birdsong. These attach seamlessly to each other to allow you to create custom counters, barriers, etc.
- Guild Bonds: A ticket which turns into crowns once deposited in a guild’s treasury. Guild Bonds are not tradeable.
- Behind the scenes changes to update our libraries.

Chess Mini Prize Box:

Spiral Knights have always been strategic thinkers.  What better way to brush up on those skills than a game of chess?  Chess Minis are objects that can move anywhere in guild hall even when you’re not in design mode and will snap to the squares in the chess room.  Each box contains a chess piece for your guild hall.  The Chess Mini Prize Box is available in the supply depot through August 8th.  Your move, Knights!

Guild Hall Prize Box:

notes.title: A Wicked Kataclysmic Confrontation
notes.content:

ATTENTION KNIGHTS

Black kats are once again storming the Moorcroft Manor Archives and consuming the precious tomes within! We need all knights of rank 4-1 and greater to gear up and retrieve Ancient Pages from these nefarious creatures.

Do the Kataclysmic Confrontation prestige mission and/or fight through kat levels in the Clockworks to find black kats. Then, visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the Mysterious Crafting Machine in Haven, with your collection of Ancient Pages, to exchange for items:

Kat Claw hood, mask, cowl
Kat Hiss hood, mask, cowl
Kat Eye hood, mask, cowl


If you “accidentally” perform a Dark Ritual and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or a Wicked Whisker. Wicked Whiskers, dropped for all present party members, allow you to craft the following gear:

Kat Claw cloak, mail, raiment
Kat Hiss cloak, mail, raiment
Kat Eye cloak, mail, raiment
Black Kat cloak, mail, raiment, hood, mask

If you have participated in a previous Kataclysmic Confrontation and still have Ancient Page tokens, they are still valid! Ancient Page tokens do not expire.

Wicked 2016 Prize Box

During this event, Spiral HQ is offering the Wicked 2016 Prize Box. Contents include:

New wicked colored accessories
Wicked Leafy Aura
Wicked Dragon Wings
Crest of Curse
Nefarious Hood
Nefarious Raiment
Wicked colored armor and helms


The Kataclysmic Confrontation will run through July 18, 2016, and details on the box can be found here. Best of luck, knights!

Steam region blocks for Japan, Korea, Taiwan, China and Hong Kong have been removed.
Slime key is now for sale in more places (Emberlight and sometimes the terminal). We suggest you continue to check with Smitty when he's around.
Fixed shadow lair conversation.

ATTENTION!

The Apocrean Harvester is at it again, and Spiral HQ needs your help in beating it back into dormancy! For a detailed brief on Cradle's previous encounters with this nefarious entity, go here.

Venture onto the Grasping Plateau, free trapped souls, and earn Apocrean Sigil tokens for your heroic deeds. Then, use these tokens at the Obelisk of Creation to craft Obsidian weapons and the Grasping Aura.

Shadow accessories

notes.title: Happy 5th Birthday, Spiral Knights!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/l3X08t3.jpg

Spiral Knights is FIVE years old! Why, that's almost old enough to wear long trousers!

(*sniffle* They grow up so fast...)

Pile into the Clockworks and help us celebrate Spiral Knights' birthday! Here is the lineup of events:

Today through April 18, 2016: Spiral HQ has assembled prize boxes from the past year together into a Surprise Box. When you open a Surprise Box, you will randomly receive a past prize box and confetti. There is also a chance to find a Stately Cap costume helm! For details on this box and its contents, visit the wiki here.

Missions: Help Biscotti, the Skylark's Head Chef, avoid disaster in two special missions - Total Caketastrophe and A Gremlin in Knead. Fight Creep Cakes and Batterbots to earn Cake Slice tokens, then visit Maskwell in Haven Town Square to exchange your tokens for:

- Cake helms
- Anniversary Prize Boxes 
- other party accessories

April 8-10, 2016: The Birdsong Trading Company is holding a three-day giveaway for the Spiral Knights Anniversary celebration! HOW DO YOU GET THE SHINIES?! Just be logged into the game for your chance to win party hats, confetti and other good stuff.

Thank you all so much for playing Spiral Knights. Have fun out there!

notes.title: A Warm Feeling Inside
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/lDCvhsQ.jpg

Knights,

What is best in life? 

Yes, yes, we can recite the thing about lamentations and defeating enemies too, but here's what it really is: Coming inside from a Winterfest snowball fight, donning comfy clothing, and settling in front of the fire with a cup of hot cocoa and the people who still think of you as a friend after that snowball fight.

As far as cuddly attire goes, Spiral HQ has got you covered (ha HA!) with the Cozy Prize Box, available through January 5, 2016! Embrace your new reputation as a veritable singularity of adorableness when you don the following:

- Pullovers (multiple colors)
- Onesies (multiple colors)
- Round Night Caps (multiple colors)
- Sallet Night Caps (multiple colors)
- Ashtail Slippers
- Dusker Slippers
- Skolver Slippers
- Snarbolax Slippers
- Vog Slippers
- Wolver Slippers

You may wish to requisition a set of ear plugs and stay away from all glass objects, as shrill squealing is a common side effect of unexpected contact with this level of cute.

Each of these boxes also has a 15% chance of including a bonus Pile of Pillows, so if you still have any friends left over from a snowball fight, you can fix that issue indoors. We're here to help.

For full details, check here. Have a cozy and delightful Winterfest!

notes.title: Merry Winterfest to All!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/4nUnLiS.jpg

It's here, knights! Winterfest is here!

Have you been naughty, or nice? Nice, right? 

No? Naughty? Why would you--

Never mind. Fine. It's fine. It's Winterfest, after all, and Winterfest is for everyone! Here's the rundown:

NEW: Winterfest Danger Rooms in the Clockworks! From these random encounters, you can collect Frozen Winterfest Wishlist tokens. Impostoclaus' trusty assistant, Randolph, is stationed by the Haven fountain and will trade these tokens for Winterfest Present Boxes, in which you may find:

Candy Striped Onesie
Festively Striped Onesie
Holly Striped Onesie
Joyous Striped Onesie
Flashy Winter Pullover
Garish Winter Pullover
Gaudy Winter Pullover
Tacky Winter Pullover
Impostoclaus Outfit

Each Winterfest Present also contains one to three Winter Confetti and Flawed Snowballs.

The Mysterious Alchemy Machine is also producing a weapon called the Peppermint Repeater. Although it sounds tasty, it is for external application only and we do not recommend licking it.

Grinchlin Assault Prestige Mission

Invade the Grinchlin base of operations on Mount Krampus and put an end to their humbug! Face a choice at each shelter - collect loot and leave the mountain, or leave the treasure and climb further toward the summit! Collect special materials from Mount Krampus to craft 5* Grinchlin reskinned weapons:

Deadly Candy Poker
Nog Blaster 
Jack Froster
Scalding Hot Cocoa
Humbug Hazer

Can you make it all the way to the summit? If so, you have a chance to win Golden or Silver Solstice Rings. These 4* trinkets protect against fire and freeze with a +1 health bonus. Leave them as-is, or combine them to craft a 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

And remember, don't eat the Grinchlin Snowballs. Those are for...well, you'll figure it out.

Save Winterfest!

Those Grinchlins just won't quit. As with last year, they aim to ruin Winterfest for everyone, and they're making a pretty strong showing. Impostoclaus wants YOU to assist him by doing the Save Winterfest prestige mission! 

If you've been naughty this year, this is a great time to redeem yourself...or just to get red, green, and white Winter Wish tokens. Trade with Randolph in Haven:

Red Winter Wishes for

Santy Sallet 
Snowy Santy Hat 
Winter Confetti (15)
Flawed Snowball (15) 
Frosty Prize Box 

Green Winter Wishes for

Santy Pith Hat 
Snowy Pith Hat 
Winter Confetti (15) 
Flawed Snowball (15)
Frosty Prize Box

White Winter Wishes for

Tailed Santy Hat 
Snowy Tailed Santy Hat
Winter Confetti (15) 
Flawed Snowball (15) 
Frosty Prize Box 

Decoration Kit Prize Boxes

Get into the spirit of Winterfest by decorating your guild hall! These boxes, provisioned by the Supply Depot, contain:

Holiday Presents (red, green, white)
Candles (red, green, white)
Winterfest Trees (red, green, white)

You may also find some other surprises!

Winterfest Table (it has a platter of cookies and milk on it)
Blue Wandering Snipe
White Flying Snipe
Green Wandering Snipe

For more information, cast your eyes over here. 

If you'd like to give gifts to your fellow knights, decorative Gift Boxes are available from the Supply Depot at a discount during Winterfest.

Winterfest is here on Spiral Knights through January 3, 2016, so tell your friends and guildies to come on over!

notes.title: Tricksy Knightses
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/T4JMPrT.png

Hello, knights!

We've been meaning to talk to you about your recent blitz through the Clockworks, during which you attracted the attention of hundreds, possibly thousands of gremlins, kats, and other unfriendly creatures. You should probably find yourself a safehouse or a disguise. Lay low for a while, because those monsters are probably plotting revenge... 

Look, we're here to help. We've got an assortment of disguise options to help you blend into the crowd and totally not stand out in the Disguise Prize Box for you. The Strangers even overheard us discussing disguises and kindly chipped in some of their hats! Odd. Anyway, here's the mix:

- Sniped Stranger Hats
- Lumberfell Beards
- Wolver Chops
- Smashing Mustaches
- Wise Whiskers
- Disguise Kits
- Stranger Hats

Each Disguise Prize Box also includes one of the following disguises, which will last you 30 days after you first equip them:

- Gun Puppy Disguise
- Gremlin Disguise
- Mechaknight Disguise
- Trojan Disguise

Each box also has a 15% chance to include one of the following:

- Eye Usables
- Personal Color Usables
- Height Modifier Usables

Disguise Prize Boxes are available through November 3, 2015, and you can find the full details of their contents here. Have fun!

notes.title: Sweet Dreams are Made of This
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/vSbNXx5.jpg

MEMORANDUM

TO: All Knights

FROM: Spiral HQ

SUBJECT: Sleep is for the Strong

Knights, is "I'll sleep when I'm dead" your motto? It shouldn't be. Quality rest is important for those who brave danger on a daily basis. It restores, rejuvenates, and revives exhausted bodies and minds. 

We at Spiral HQ are concerned about a spike in the number of knights who push themselves to the limit with lack of sleep, and Medical has noted a similar uptick in knights who want to sleep, but can't. We suspect this is at least partly due to recent Apocrean activity in the Clockworks. While that problem can be addressed martially, sometimes a knight just needs a comfortable break from routine. For interested knights, we are making available the Slumber Prize Box, which contains a variety of items to assist you in your quest for repose:

- Sleepy Night Cap
- Lucid Night Cap
- Dreamer Night Cap
- Wooly Onesie
- Sweet Dreams (your weapon against nightmares)
- Teddy Bear Buckler (shield)
- Slumber accessories
- Slumber armors and helms

If you still can't sleep, feel free to roar through the Clockworks in your new jammies. It'll at least confuse the monsters.

This box will be available through September 1, 2015! Get the full item rundown here.

notes.title: Apocrean Harvester Alert!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/A9pcxag.jpg

NOW HEAR THIS:

The Apocrean Harvester is once again stalking the Clockworks! Spiral HQ requests that all available knights assist in the effort to drive this hideous entity back into hiding. For a detailed brief on Cradle's previous encounters with the Harvester, go here.

Venture onto the Grasping Plateau, free trapped souls, and earn Apocrean Sigil tokens for your heroic deeds. Then, use these tokens at the Obelisk of Creation to craft Obsidian weapons and the Grasping Aura, shown here.

http://i.imgur.com/RoruLkh.gif  

A little advice on hunting the Harvester: don't do it alone, and try not to lose sight of your teammates! Also, bring extra underwear. 

Obsidian Prize Boxes

During all this, the Supply Depot is stocking Apocrean themed guild hall furniture, and Obsidian Prize Boxes which may contain the following:

Obsidian Hoods 
Obsidian Mantles
Apocrean Crowns
Apocrean Disciple Wings
Shadow accessories

For details on the Obsidian Prize Box, head over here. This event runs through August 25, 2015.

Knights, we don't have to explain to you the effect fire has on the enemy. You've experienced that joy for yourselves on numerous occasions. Also, burning things is fun.

notes.title: Something Wicked This Way Comes
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/6KRYNkX.jpg

MEMORANDUM

TO: All Knights

FROM: Spiral HQ

SUBJECT: Something Wicked

Knights, 

Today Spiral HQ introduces a line of gear that should help you blend into environs riddled with cursed monsters. We bring these to you in the Wicked Prize Box, with contents including the following:

- Wicked helms
- Wicked armors
- Wicked accessories
- Crest of Curse (new)
- Nefarious Hood (new)
- Nefarious Raiment (new)

SUMMARY: These items are wicked awesome, and will be available to you through June 16, 2015. For the full breakdown of possible prizes, check here.

P.S. The use of curse words is still restricted while wearing items that appear cursed. Just putting that out there.

notes.title: Kat Scratch Fever!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/RaUzTJX.jpg

ATTENTION ALL KNIGHTS

The tomes held in the Moorcroft Manor Archives must be made of the freshest, most delectable sashimi grade fish, because black kats are flooding the area and eating the pages! We need all able personnel--knights of rank 4-1 and greater--to suit up and assist in the retrieval of Ancient Pages from these nasty creatures, because the compassionate catch-and-release traps we set down after the last time just aren't doing the trick. 

Do the Kataclysmic Confrontation prestige mission and/or fight through kat levels in the Clockworks to find black kats. Then, visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the Mysterious Crafting Machine in Haven, with your collection of Ancient Pages, and craft stuff:

- Kat Claw hood, mask, cowl
- Kat Hiss hood, mask, cowl
- Kat Eye hood, mask, cowl

If you happen to perform (accidentally, we assume) a Dark Ritual (yes, THAT dark ritual) and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or a Wicked Whisker. With Wicked Whiskers, dropped for all present party members, the following gear can be made:

- Kat Claw cloak, mail, raiment
- Kat Hiss cloak, mail, raiment
- Kat Eye cloak, mail, raiment
- Black Kat cloak, mail, raiment, hood, mask

If you have participated in a previous Kataclysmic Confrontation and still have Ancient Page tokens, they are still valid! Ancient Page tokens do not expire.

Our new Kat Forecasting Intern predicts that the Kataclysmic Confrontation will run through June 16, 2015. Good luck out there, knights.

notes.title: More New Vanguard Missions!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/ts8Mlc4.jpg

Today's patch features the release of more Rank Missions! This patch includes five new Rank 10-2 missions that unravel some long standing mysteries while weaving new tales and adventures. These missions must be played in order.

Rank 10-2

After strange interference is detected deep within Firestorm Citadel, the Vanguards embark on a series of missions that will have them returning to old stomping grounds and beyond. Reunite with old friends and foes alike and discover a new charge for the future of the Spiral Order.

Also, A Bug Fix

- Writhing Tendrils now display the correct icon for the back accessory slot.

notes.title: Happy Anniversary!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/HxhK1kk.png

Spiral Knights is four years old! Can you believe it?

Join Spiral HQ and the Strangers as they celebrate Spiral Knights' birthday! We have several things going on, so let's get to it!

Today through April 7, 2015: Spiral HQ has assembled prize boxes from the past year together into a Surprise Box. When you open a Surprise Box, you will randomly receive a past prize box and confetti. There is also a chance to find a Stately Cap costume helm! For details on this box and its contents, visit the wiki here.

April 1-7, 2015: Help Biscotti, the Skylark's Head Chef, avoid disaster in two special missions - Total Caketastrophe and A Gremlin in Knead. Fight Creep Cakes and Batterbots to earn Cake Slice tokens, then visit Maskwell in Haven Town Square to exchange your tokens for:

- Cake helms
- Anniversary Prize Boxes 
- other party accessories

New this year in the Anniversary Prize Boxes: the Prismatic Grand Topper, the Prismatic Field Cap, and the Prismatic Plumed Cap.

NOTE: Although this event does start on April 1, it's not a trick. Pinky swear. That's why we're announcing it now and not on that day!

April 3-5, 2015: The Birdsong Trading Company is holding a three-day giveaway for the Spiral Knights Anniversary celebration! HOW DO YOU GET STUFF?! Just be logged into the game for your chance to win party hats, confetti and other fun prizes.

Go forth and have fun! Thank you all for playing Spiral Knights. <3

- Cake helms

- other party accessories

notes.title: Beating the Cold
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/U5gRLsU.jpg

MEMORANDUM

TO: All Knights

FROM: Spiral HQ

SUBJECT: Temperature Extremes

Knights, you may have noticed we had a bit of a cold snap recently. The temperature got low enough that we all bundled up and threw snowballs at each other, but not enough to inconvenience anyone. We count that as a win!

However, the cold we experience may not always be the type that simply makes you reach for a warm, spicy beverage. In fact, it may cause your warm, spicy beverage to freeze and shatter on the ground. Best to be prepared.

To that end, Spiral HQ has embarked upon OPERATION GELID. An assortment of items are available to you, including the following:

- Glacial armor and helms
- Glacial accessories
- Arctic Disciple Wings
- Arctic Crown
- Arctic Shackles
- Arctic Pauldrons
- Arctic Rogue Mail
- Arctic Rogue Mask

These items look frozen solid on the outside--for camo reasons, and also because it looks formidable--and they're mighty toasty on the inside. Added bonus: if you do get hit with a snowball, you won't even feel it. The Glacial Prize Box is available to you through January 20, 2015. For the full item list and other details, look here.

SUMMARY:Your body is now ready for extreme inclement weather.

P.S. We don't recommend spilling liquid on this gear; you'll have to chisel it off.

notes.title: Winterfest, Winterfest, Winterfest!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/hkUKIX6.jpg

Happy Winterfest, knights! 

We don't care if you've been naughty or nice--Winterfest is for everyone!

Grinchlin Assault Prestige Mission

The Grinchlins have vowed to destroy Impostoclaus and steal all his presents! Spiral HQ has located the Grinchlin base of operations on Mount Krampus and tasked you with putting an end to their humbug. This faction of Gremlins is very stingy and will not drop loot during battle. Instead, their treasure is stored in shelters throughout the stronghold. Face a choice at each shelter - collect the loot and leave the mountain, or leave the treasure and climb further toward the summit! Collect special materials from Mount Krampus to craft 5* Grinchlin reskinned weapons:

- Deadly Candy Poker
- Nog Blaster
- Jack Froster
- Scalding Hot Cocoa
- Humbug Hazer

Can you make it all the way to the summit? If so, you have a chance to win Golden or Silver Solstice Rings. These 4* trinkets protect against fire and freeze with a +1 health bonus. Leave them as-is, or combine them to craft a 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

And remember, don't eat the Grinchlin Snowballs. Those are for...well, you'll figure it out.

Save Winterfest!

Those Grinchlins just won't quit. As with last year, they aim to ruin Winterfest for everyone, and they're making a pretty strong showing. Impostoclaus wants YOU to assist him by doing the Save Winterfest prestige mission! 

If you've been naughty this year, this is a great time to redeem yourself...or just to get red, green, and white Winter Wish tokens. Impostoclaus' trusty assistant, Randolph, is stationed by the Haven fountain and will trade:

Red Winter Wishes for

- Santy Sallet
- Snowy Santy Hat
- Winter Confetti (15)
- Flawed Snowball (15) 
- Frosty Prize Box 

Green Winter Wishes for

- Santy Pith Hat 
- Snowy Pith Hat
- Winter Confetti (15) 
- Flawed Snowball (15)
- Frosty Prize Box

White Winter Wishes for

- Tailed Santy Hat
- Snowy Tailed Santy Hat
- Winter Confetti (15) 
- Flawed Snowball (15)
- Frosty Prize Box 

Decoration Kit Prize Boxes

Get into the spirit of Winterfest by decorating your guild hall! These boxes, provisioned by the Supply Depot, contain:

- Holiday Presents (red, green, white)
- Candles (red, green, white)
- Winterfest Trees (red, green, white)

You may also find some other surprises!

- Winterfest Table (it has a platter of cookies and milk on it)
- Blue Wandering Snipe
- White Flying Snipe
- Green Wandering Snipe

For more information, cast your eyes over here. 

If you'd like to give gifts to your fellow knights, decorative Gift Boxes are available from the Supply Depot at a discount during Winterfest.

Winterfest is here through January 2, 2015, so tell your friends and guildies to pop by while it lasts!

New Handguns have been added to several Handgun lines.

Freeze/Shadow Magnus (3-5 Star)
- Tundrus
- Mega Tundrus
- Winter Grave

Piercing Antigua (4-5 Star)
- Raptor
- Gilded Griffin


New gunner oriented Armors & Helms have been added.
These include:

Padded Armor & Cap (1 Star) - normal

Pathfinder Armor & Helm (2-5 Star) - normal/piercing

Sentinel Armor & Helm (2-5 Star) - normal/elemental
- Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Woven Falcon Sentinel Armor & Helm

- Woven Snakebite Sentinel Armor & Helm

Shade Armor & Helm (2-5 Star) - normal/shadow
- Shade Armor & Helm
- Woven Falcon Shade Armor & Helm
- Woven Firefly Shade Armor & Helm
- Woven Grizzly Shade Armor & Helm
- Woven Snakebite Shade Armor & Helm
- Plated Falcon Shade Armor & Helm
- Plated Firefly Shade Armor & Helm

- Plated Snakebite Shade Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Shade Armor & Helm
- Sacred Firefly Shade Armor & Helm

- Sacred Snakebite Shade Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Ghost Armor & Helm
- Sacred Firefly Ghost Armor & Helm
- Sacred Grizzly Ghost Armor & Helm
- Sacred Snakebite Ghost Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Hex Armor & Helm
- Sacred Firefly Hex Armor & Helm
- Sacred Grizzly Hex Armor & Helm
- Sacred Snakebite Hex Armor & Helm


Handgun Mechanic and Balance Changes:
A number of Handguns have had their mechanics changed in order to better balance all the gun lines. 

All Handguns
- Increased movement speed while firing and charging
- Increased reloading movement speed
- Reduced cooldown animations for all guns that stop movement

Magnus Line 
- Charge attack now pierces through monsters
- Charge attack bullet speed slightly decreased
- Charge attack no longer prones the wielder

Autogun Line
- Decreased windup time for attack
- Increased range and bullet speed

Antigua Line
- Changed all family damage bonuses to ‘High’
- Increased polygon count for all models

Polaris Line
- Increased bullet speed
- Reduced the damage for all versions

Catalyzer Line
- Normal attacks now cling to mobs and charge shots detonate them
- Charge shot has an aura around it that activates any catalyzer orbitals within it
  
Misc Changes
Stun Gun - Increased stun chance slightly
Super Stun Gun - Added stun chance to regular attacks
Frost Gun - Increased freeze chance
Zapper - Added shock chance to regular attacks
Pepperbox - Increased damage slightly
Fiery Pepperbox - Increased damage slightly and added fire chance to regular attacks
Volcanic Pepperbox - Increased damage slightly and added fire chance to regular attacks
Plague Needle - Increased damage slightly and increased poison chance on charge attack

Bug Fixes:
Kilowatt Pulsar, Radiant Pulsar, Polaris - Tooltip display corrected to show proper damage
Firotech Alchemer MKII - Tooltip display corrected to show status effect
Shadow Driver - Tooltip display corrected to show proper damage
Needle Shot - Model now displays correct texture

NOTE: For the rest of December, the Prize Wheel in the Clockworks will have an increased chance to give out materials for gun recipes. You can get the recipes themselves from Basil. 

Have fun and stay safe, knights!

notes.content:

Knights:

Rhendon is looking for recruits to join the Scarlet Scouts! 

Scarlet Scouts, somewhat akin to the Recon Rangers, are tasked with traveling fast and light across Cradle to quickly extract intel and other assets from dangerous situations. 

You might recall your own extraction not so long ago, when Rhendon guided you from your crash site to Haven. If you want to help out with these ongoing efforts, supplies can be found in the Hazardous Prize Box, available through November 11, 2014. These contain such items as:

- Scarlet Scout Crest
- Hazardous armor and helm costumes
- Hazardous Hedge Coat
- The Final Gasp (shield)
- Anti-Hazard Spikes (back accessory)

For your safety and enjoyment, each box also contains 3-5 Party Flares. 

Details on the Hazardous Prize Box and its contents may be found here.

notes.title: The Harvest Festival: Dark, Like Your Heart
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/JxNVjD0.jpg

Knights,

It's time.

The Dark Harvest Festival returns to Cradle, and with it the mischievous Punkin King and his gourdlings! 

You can find the Punkin King in the daily prestige mission, The Dark Harvest. He may also "punk" you at random in the Clockworks. Be on your guard! Collect candy tokens, then trade with Maskwell in Haven Town Square for:

Frankenzom masks
Spookat masks
Phantom masks
Scarab masks (new!)
Harvest Prize Boxes

Should you find yourself in possession of a new crafting material, a visit to the Mysterious Alchemy Machine may be in order.

In addition, we have a special assignment: please investigate the rumors of a new type of gourdling. Initial reports suggest they ride mounts into battle. It's all very grim...

More about the Dark Harvest Festival, including Harvest Prize Box contents can be found here. This year, it runs through November 2, 2014. Your candy tokens and Maskwell will stick around through November 10, 2014.

notes.title: On Staying Grounded
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/os4G65s.jpg

MEMORANDUM

TO: All Knights

FROM: Spiral HQ

SUBJECT: On Staying Grounded

Thank you for your assistance in last month's OPERATION THWACK, which was a partial success in that we discovered Gremlins easily sniff out knights disguised as Gremlins, despite liberal application of Thwacker Body Spray.

Based upon this new, current information, we have recalibrated our infiltration strategy. What do Gremlins live and work near constantly, yet pay little heed to, and which definitely don't smell like a Gremlin?

Constructs, knights. Constructs. Yes, these manufactured monsters have the full run of Gremlin territory, no questions asked. If caught, a disguised knight can simply jerk and flail like one of the other malfunctioning machines Gremlins keep on hand. 

We are abandoning OPERATION THWACK for now, and commencing OPERATION ZAP. We have procured and retrofitted Construct gear to transform any knight in need, and we bring it to you in the Construct Prize Box through October 13, 2014:

Costume Items
Mecha Suit
Mecha Helm
Gun Pup Helm
Accessories
Gear Halo
Wind-up Key
Exhaust Pipes
Prismatic Pylons
Wrench

Details on this positively electrifying array of items can be found here.

SUMMARY: OPERATION ZAP begins now! Stay grounded and positive, knights, and relay any intel you find back to those in charge at Spiral HQ. 

P.S. Watt puns?

notes.title: They're Baaaaaack...
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/hjIKQSf.png

ATTENTION ALL KNIGHTS

THIS IS NOT A DRILL

Despite rigorous precautionary measures, black kats are reappearing en masse and consuming the treasures held in the Moorcroft Manor Archives! 

We need all able personnel--knights of rank 4-1 and greater--to suit up and assist in the retrieval of Ancient Pages from these voracious creatures. Do the Kataclysmic Confrontation prestige mission and/or fight through kat levels in the Clockworks to find black kats. Then, visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the Mysterious Crafting Machine in Haven, with your collection of Ancient Pages, and craft stuff:

Kat Claw hood, mask, cowl
Kat Hiss hood, mask, cowl
Kat Eye hood, mask, cowl

If you happen to perform (accidentally, we assume) a Dark Ritual (yes, THAT dark ritual) and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or a Wicked Whisker. With Wicked Whiskers, dropped for all present party members, the following new costume items can be made:

Kat Claw cloak, mail, raiment
Kat Hiss cloak, mail, raiment
Kat Eye cloak, mail, raiment
Black Kat cloak, mail, raiment, hood, mask

If you have participated in a previous Kataclysmic Confrontation and still have Ancient Page tokens, those are still valid! Ancient Page tokens do not expire.

For miraculous, unexplainable science reasons, we are able to predict that the Kataclysmic Confrontation will run through September 29, 2014. Thank you for your assistance in this important mission!

notes.title: Gremlins and You
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/82geISA.jpg

MEMORANDUM

TO: All Knights

FROM: Spiral HQ

SUBJECT: Gremlins and You

Knights, our intel on Gremlins is sparse at best. Because these creatures tend to attack on sight, getting close to them will never be easy. And yet, we must do better; Gremlins are deeply connected to the Clockworks and by extension, to Cradle's mysteries. 

We are therefore implementing a voluntary program, OPERATION THWACK, in an attempt to pry into the Gremlin mind. To interested knights, we are supplying various items of Gremlin make: 

Gremlin Suits
Gremlin Helmets
Gremlin Goggles
Drakon Pods: Drakon comes disguised as a Gun Puppy

In addition, you may also receive a Gremlin Disguise (these disintegrate after 30 days because of plausible deniability reasons). 

These items will be available in the Gremlin Prize Box through August 26, 2014. All details can be found here.

SUMMARY: Become the enemy. Behave as a Gremlin behaves, fight as a Gremlin fights, smell as a Gremlin smells. Then report your findings to Spiral HQ, preferably after bathing.

P.S. Sneezing while wearing a Gremlin mask is contraindicated.

notes.title: Regarding Slimes
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/woMRZV0.jpgU JELLY?

MEMORANDUM

To: All Knights

From: Spiral HQ

Subject: The Slime Family of Monsters

Spiral HQ Medical has recently tracked an uptick in knights visiting the infirmary with digestive issues. Please note that members of the slime monster family (jellies, lichens, polyps, glop drops, Royal Jelly, Ice Queen) are not edible and should not be ingested under any circumstance, despite the fact that some may resemble a confection.

On a related note, while studying slime-compromised knights, our scientists discovered new ways of incorporating slime material into camo. You may find an assortment of these in the Slime Prize Box, which may contain the following:

Node Slime Masks
Node Slime Guards
Node Slime Crusher (sword)
Node Slime Wall (shield)
Writhing Tendrils
Node Field Aura

For details, please go here: http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Slime_Prize_Box_Promotion_July_2014. These boxes will be available to you through July 15, 2014.

SUMMARY: Slimes are for wearing, not for eating. Thank you for your attention to this urgent matter. 

P.S. You may now commence to make "U JELLY" jokes. That is all.

http://i.imgur.com/uFsk9vI.jpgThe Apocrean Harvester Returns!

ATTENTION!

The Apocrean Harvester has returned to Cradle, even daring to make its presence known in Haven. Spiral HQ needs your help in containing it! For a detailed brief on Cradle's previous encounter with this nefarious entity, go here: http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Shroud_of_the_Apocrea

Venture onto the Grasping Plateau, free trapped souls, and earn Apocrean Sigil tokens for your heroic deeds. Then, use these tokens at the Obelisk of Creation to craft Obsidian weapons and the new Grasping Aura.  

A word of advice when tackling this mission, knights: bring backup. Also, current recon reports suggest that the graveyard area of the Grasping Plateau may have expanded somewhat. 

Obsidian Prize Boxes

During all this, the Supply Depot is stocking new Apocrean themed guild hall furniture, and Obsidian Prize Boxes which may contain the following:

Obsidian Hoods 
Obsidian Mantles
Apocrean Crowns
Apocrean Disciple Wings
Shadow accessories

For details on the Obsidian Prize Box, head over here: http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Obsidian_Prize_Box_Promotion_June_2014. This event runs through June 30, 2014.

notes.title: Mission Update and Summertime Splash!
notes.content:
Mission Update!

- The Laboratory in the Haven Garrison now updates with scenes based on your progress through rank missions.
- The following rank missions have been changed:
Rank 1-4 - Crossing the Chasm - Mission finale has new story hints.
Rank 2-3 - The Collector - Mission finale has new story hints.
Rank 4-2 - A New Threat - New mission.
Rank 4-3 - Shocking Sentient Sentries - New miniboss fight.
Rank 5-2 - The Sovereign Slime - Mission text rewrite and treasure room rework.
Rank 6-2 - Built to Destroy! - Mission text rewrite and treasure room rework.
Rank 7-1 - Darkest Depths - Mission text rewrite.
Rank 7-3 - Spark and Roar - Mission ending reworked.
Rank 8-2 - The Great Escape - Mission text rewrite and new miniboss fight.
Rank 9-3 - The King of Ashes - Treasure room rework.

Splash Party!
 
Knights! Does it seem you're under constant assault from the inhabitants of Cradle? Do you feel like you need a little ‘down time’ to unwind and relax? No, oh, ok then. Back into the Clockworks!

Yes? Oh, great! Spiral HQ has put together a vacation package just for you! Grab a seat at the edge of the sparkling, blue Haven fountain and put your feet up while wearing your new Splash armor! Don’t worry, Kozma assures us that these costumes are guaranteed not to rust or corrode after exposure to water. Stir up a some mischief with a water balloon fight!

If you're looking for a little adventure, while still feeling like you’re on holiday, equip your knight with one of the new 5* summertime weapon reskins: Deadly Charcoaler, Spiral Soaker or Furious Fork! For all the details, click here. Splash Prize Boxes will be available through June 3rd!

notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/MHGmsG2.jpgNew Mission: A Gremlin in Knead

Skylark Head Chef Biscotti has big plans for this anniversary celebration, and she commissioned Groat, a Gremlin chef, to help with the baking. No one has seen Groat since Biscotti delivered the last crate of batter, and she's worried the responsibility may have gone to his head. Or maybe he snuck off to eat the batter. Battle Current Cakes and Batterbots in the Gremlin kitchen to get to the bottom of this mix-up.

As in years past, Maskwell will be stationed in Haven Town Square to trade an assortment of treats for your Cake Slice Tokens. Hunter Prize BoxNemesis Prize BoxSurge Prize BoxGourmet Prize BoxMoorcroft Prize BoxPolar Prize BoxStormy Prize BoxObsidian Prize BoxDangerous Prize BoxAncient Prize BoxRose Regalia Prize BoxColossal Prize Box

notes.title: The Love Puppy Sends its Regards!
notes.content:
Love is in the air, so let's celebrate! In anticipation of Valentine's Day, we've made a selection of lovely items available on the Supply Depot through February 15th, 2014:the Heart Eyes usable (new)the Crest of Love accessory (new)Love AurasForever Love Puppy Masks (non-expiring)Red snipes for your guild hallLast year, many of you wished to give Valentine's Day gifts to each other, so this year these items come unbound upon purchase! Did you just come out of the oven? Because you're so hot, you'd make Lord Vanaduke himself sweat. 

...Anyway, we've also added Gift Boxes this year! Get empty gift boxes from the Supply Depot, wrap up your presents, and write a note* for your special someones, bestest BFFs, and fiercest frenemies.

Only the finest for you, because exploring the Clockworks without you is like a broken pencil...pointless. We wish we were cross-eyed, so we could see you twice. Knights, if you were words on a page, you'd be what we call fine print.**

* Please, for everyone's sake, make sure your lovelorn prose obeys the Spiral Knights Terms of Service. start honing your skills.
